This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

The M4 Sherman's infamous "Ronson" reputation? A post-war myth. The real story: deployed globally from WWII through the 1970s, the Sherman wasn't designed as a tank destroyer but for infantry support. Its "flaming coffin" legend stems from ammunition storage, not gasoline engines. Discover how one of history's most misunderstood tanks actually excelled at its intended role. #SimpleHistory
